Which statement about an ionic bond is correct?
A
It is a strong electrostatic attraction between cations and anions.
B
It is a strong electrostatic attraction between protons and electrons.
C
It is a weak electrostatic attraction between cations and anions.
D
It is a weak electrostatic attraction between protons and electrons.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a strong electrostatic attraction between cations and anions.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a strong electrostatic attraction between protons and electrons.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a weak electrostatic attraction between cations and anions.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a weak electrostatic attraction between protons and electrons.
